list.text: Congrats on your Orange League victory!\nWe watched everything from the TV.

then.text: I wasn’t expecting to call you so soon, but something just happened.
Our machines detected that the Mysterious Ball is emitting much more energy once again.
So please come to my lab as soon as you can, I'll need your help once again.
We'll be waiting for you here.

else.text: I can see you're having a great adventure in the Orange Archipelago.
You can make it even more interesting by investigating the remaining dens!
Don't forget you can see all the locations in the Map on your Pokégear.
This is very important for our research.

then.text: The Coliseum is closed for now, due to the Annual Festival of the Legend in Shamouti Island.

else.text: To face the Champion you'll need the 4 Orange League Badges.
Please come back when you have all of them.

list.text: I watched someone challenge Drake once...\nThey didn’t last long.
I heard Drake watches recordings of every badge match.\nBy the time you face him he already knows you.
Everyone who walks this path believes they’re ready.

lines: EndSpeech: Como eu perdi para você?

list.text: You seem ready to face the last Orange League challenge.
You look pretty strong.\nLet me battle you!
Win or lose, enjoy the moment.
